issue_request: FHIR-33062 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction for a FHIR-core StructureDefinition example. It reported that the executable Composition profile example referenced the nonexistent http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/document-section-library canonical, causing snapshot generation failures, and the final Jira discussion clarified that the reference should be changed to http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/example-section-library.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation. Commit 940ee84562907c714bddc8cab995c287d26c9fbe changed the master-side structuredefinition-example-composition.xml references from document-section-library to example-section-library, and commit 2037bdcc78 carried the same change for R4B. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-33062 existed on the combined branch.
additional_context: StructureDefinition remains active in source/fhir.ini, and current source still defines and lists StructureDefinition/example-section-library. Later FHIR-48828 removed the example-composition core profile and its StructureDefinition examples-list entry, so the old executable Composition profile example no longer exists in current core source. The remaining document-section-library strings are only illustrative profiling.html snippets under http://hl7.org/fhir/example/StructureDefinition/, not the broken built StructureDefinition profile reference from FHIR-33062.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope StructureDefinition source no longer contains http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/document-section-library, the intended example-section-library canonical is present in the surviving section-library example source and examples list, and the removed example-composition profile cannot still carry the old reference.
